build_pose_estimator_model: build a PoseEstimator with a 18-layer ResNet encoder for monocular pose estimation
run_pose_estimator_forward: run the PoseEstimator forward pass on stacked image frames to predict camera poses
create_resnet_encoder: create a ResnetEncoder with configurable layer depth for multi-image feature extraction

review_transformation_from_parameters: review the transformation_from_parameters utility to convert axisangle and translation into 4x4 matrices
